name: qr-code-button
summary: A pill that morphs into a card with a real, scannable QR code.
props: What the code encodes: a URL, a payment link, a ticket id.
Side of the code in points; the card wraps it.
Pill colour. The card stays white so the code scans.
Screen reader label for the pill.
behavior: Press swells the pill; it glides into the card while its label fades out and the code fades and scales in. Close glides it back.
Reserves the open card's size up front, so nothing around it moves and every control stays inside its own bounds (taps work on Android).
Encoded in the component: UTF-8 bytes, error correction M, smallest version that fits, mask chosen by the spec's penalty rules. Always dark on white so it scans in dark mode too.
Calls onCopy with the value and flips to a tick and "Copied" for 1.5 s.
A light impact on open, a success tap on Copy, a tick on close.
Opens and closes with a short fade.
A button with an expanded state; the code reads as "QR code for …".
